title: Segment plan
description: One segment of a route as the state machine sees it: the router contract's typed operation (REQ-ORD-37), at one provider, with the segment's id. A transition of a nondeterministic automaton from one (node, asset) pair to another (REQ-STM-7); a withdrawal, route or deposit changes no value. That a withdrawal, route or deposit keeps its asset, a route's nodes differ and an exchange stays at one node can't be stated here; the Rust types check them, as the router's own Operation::check does. Schemas that embed this shape close it themselves with unevaluatedProperties.

segment_id.description: Unique within its order for the order's whole life. Inputs name a segment by this id, never by position, so a report about a segment a recalculation replaced matches nothing current.

provider.description: The provider the segment runs at.
